items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions Edmond Hall as someone copied by young guys; INTERVIEWEE does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with Edmond Hall.

ctx.x: Now, if you take any European guy or any young guy or any of this, ten thousand of them copied George Lewis, ten thousand copied Barney, ten thousand of them copied Edmond Hall. Why do you think that the New Orleans guys had such individuality and modern young kids don't? Do you have any theory of that?
I really have never stopped... The guys...
